title.en: Crusoe closes initial $3.9 billion Series F at $30.9 billion valuation
title.zhHans: Crusoe 完成 39 亿美元 F 轮初始交割，投后估值达 309 亿美元

searchSummary.en: On September 17, 2026, Crusoe announced the initial closing of an anticipated $3.9 billion Series F round at a $30.9 billion post-money valuation. Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital, and Valor Equity Partners co-led the round. Construction plans and contracted-value claims remain company-reported future or multi-year figures.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026 年 9 月 17 日，Crusoe 宣布一轮预计总额 39 亿美元的 F 轮融资完成初始交割，投后估值为 309 亿美元。Atreides Management、Mubadala Capital 与 Valor Equity Partners 共同领投。建设计划及合同总价值仍属于公司披露的未来或多年期数据。

summary.en: On September 17, 2026, Crusoe announced the initial closing of an anticipated $3.9 billion Series F round at a $30.9 billion post-money valuation. Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital, and Valor Equity Partners co-led the round. Construction plans and contracted-value claims remain company-reported future or multi-year figures.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 9 月 17 日，Crusoe 宣布一轮预计总额 39 亿美元的 F 轮融资完成初始交割，投后估值为 309 亿美元。Atreides Management、Mubadala Capital 与 Valor Equity Partners 共同领投。建设计划及合同总价值仍属于公司披露的未来或多年期数据。

narrative.en: The initial closing adds capital to an AI infrastructure operator, but the announcement does not by itself establish a change in market rules, supply structure, or completed external infrastructure. Crusoe says it plans to use the financing to expand data-center and modular-facility programs. Those plans, and its reported multi-year contracted value, remain separate from outcomes observed by the evidence cutoff.
narrative.zhHans: 这次初始交割为一家 AI 基础设施运营商增加了资本，但公告本身不能证明市场规则、供给结构或外部基础设施已经发生变化。Crusoe 表示计划将融资用于扩展数据中心和模块化设施项目；这些计划以及公司披露的多年期合同总价值，与证据截止日前已经观察到的结果是两回事。

text.en: Crusoe announced the initial closing of an anticipated $3.9 billion Series F at a $30.9 billion post-money valuation.
text.zhHans: Crusoe 宣布一轮预计总额 39 亿美元的 F 轮融资完成初始交割，投后估值为 309 亿美元。

text.en: The transaction was described as an initial closing, and planned infrastructure construction is not an observed consequence of the financing at the evidence cutoff.
text.zhHans: 该交易被描述为初始交割；截至证据截止日，计划中的基础设施建设尚不能算作融资已经产生的后果。
